Date 22.7.31

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, JULY 22, 1931

NEW CHINESE GUNBOAT
BUILDING IN JAPAN
NANKING, July 21.—It is
learned at the Ministry of the
Navy to-day that the official launch-
ing of the new gunboat Ninghai,
which is now under construction
in Japan, will take place on
October 10, the National Day. Ac-
cording to present plans, Admiral
Chen Shao-kuan is expected to
proceed to Japan to officiate at the
ceremony. Construction of the
warship will be completed at the
Japanese shipyard early in May
of next year, it is understood.

Rear-Admiral Li Shih-chis,
Director of the General Affairs
Department of the Ministry, is
likely to be appointed captain of
the new gunboat.

The vessel, it is learned, is 350
feet in length, 39 feet in width
with a draught of 13 feet and dis-
placement of 3,000 tons. Equipped
with seven guns, and having a
speed of 25 knots an hour and a
total crew of 500, the new fight-
ing craft will be one of the finest
in the Chinese navy.—Kuo Min.

(批：For Information)
(批：Atts. D.S.I.)

《字林西报》，1931年7月22日，星期三

中国新炮舰
在日本建造
南京，7月21日电。— 今日从海军部获悉，目前正在日本建造的新炮舰“宁海”号将于10月10日国庆日举行正式下水仪式。据目前的计划，陈绍宽（Chen Shao-kuan）海军上将预计将前往日本主持该仪式。据悉，该战舰将于明年5月初在日本造船厂完工。

海军部总务司司长李世基（Li Shih-chis，音译）海军少将可能被任命为该新炮舰的舰长。

据悉，该舰长350英尺，宽39英尺，吃水13英尺，排水量3,000吨。配备七门火炮，航速每小时25节，船员总数500人，这艘新型战斗舰艇将成为中国海军中最优秀的舰艇之一。— 引自《国民新闻》（Kuo Min）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. I. REC. STATION,
No. S. B. D. 2604
Date July 21, 1931.
21 - 7 - 31

Subject (in full) Vice-Admiral Li Shih-cha (李世甲)

Made by D.S.I. Montgomery Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.O.I.

With reference to the attached cutting from the
North China Daily News dated July 21, 1931, enquiries elicit
the information that the above mentioned Chinese Vice-Admiral
occupies an administrative post as director of general affairs
for the Ministry of the Navy. He is to all intents and purposes
non-combatant and his duties are limited to business affairs
in connection with the purchase of materials and matters per-
taining thereto. It is understood that he left to-day per
s.s. "Shanghai Maru" for Japan where he will inspect the
new Chinese cruiser "Ning-hai" which is due to be launched on
October 10, 1931.

The information at our disposal is that Vice-Admiral
Li Shih-cha is a native of Fokien aged about 43. He was
educated at the Foochow Naval College and has held various
positions under the Ministry of Navy. At one time he was
Aide-de-Camp to the Minister of Navy. His residence is at
Nanking.

J. Montgomery
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 1931年7月21日。
31年7月21日

主题（全称） 李世甲（Li Shih-cha）海军中将

由特别调查股蒙哥马利（Montgomery）制作 经首席调查官亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson）转发

参照附上的1931年7月21日《字林西报》剪报，经查询获悉，上述中国海军中将担任海军部总务司司长的行政职务。他实际上属于非战斗人员，其职责仅限于与物资采购及相关事务有关的业务工作。据悉，他今日乘坐“上海丸”号轮船（s.s. "Shanghai Maru"）前往日本，他将在那里视察定于1931年10月10日下水的中国新巡洋舰“宁海”号。

我方掌握的信息显示，李世甲（Li Shih-cha）海军中将是福建人，年龄约43岁。他毕业于福州船政学堂（Foochow Naval College），曾在海军部担任各种职务。他曾任海军总长副官。其寓所在南京。

J. 蒙哥马利（Montgomery）
特别调查股股长

特别分部主管警官。
